# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 8 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 8 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_008_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 8

**8:1** Joachim and Anna walked home in wonder, praising God every step of the way — their little girl hadn't looked back once. From that day on, Mary lived in the temple like a dove kept in a sacred nest, fed by the hand of an angel.

**8:2** Years passed. When Mary turned twelve, the priests called a council to discuss the problem she now presented: "Mary has been in the temple of the Lord for twelve years. She is becoming a woman. What do we do with her? We cannot let her defile the sanctuary."

**8:3** The council turned to the high priest: "You are the one who stands before the altar of God. Go in and pray about this. Whatever God shows you, we'll do it."

**8:4** The high priest put on his robe with its twelve golden bells and went into the Holy of Holies to pray. There, an angel appeared to him and said: "Zechariah! Zechariah! Go out and gather all the widowers of the people. Tell each one to bring a staff. God will give a sign to one of them — and that man will become Mary's husband."

**8:5** Heralds fanned out across all of Judea. The trumpet of the Lord rang out, and men came running from every direction.
